from.place: The finite free tensor calculation of the completed extension-by-zero comparison, split into its degreewise basis and total-tensor assembly steps.

title: Assembly of degreewise basis coproducts through the total tensor
statement: Given the degreewise supported basis coproducts for the ordered negative Koszul complex, their total-tensor assembly with an arbitrary coefficient complex K is the subset-indexed cofan with legs ringedNegativeKoszulSummand.

source.place: Tag 0A0E, lemma-derived-completion-koszul, finite free tensor calculation.

proof.text: Apply the universal property of the total tensor degreewise and preservation of the supplied basis coproducts under tensoring. Reindex pairs (p,n) with p+n=q by the subset cardinality; the inverse right unitor identifies each resulting leg with ringedNegativeKoszulSummand.

lean.statement:
theorem isColimit_ringedNegativeKoszulTensor_of_basis
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) {A : Type z} [CommRing A]
    (ρ : A →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring (O.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat))
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin (r + 1) → A) (m : ℕ) (K : ringedSiteComplex O) (q : ℤ)
    (h : ∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk
      ((ringedNegativeKoszul O (r + 1)
        (fun i ↦ ⟨(ρ (a i)).val, (ρ (a i)).property⟩) m).X n)
      (fun I : {I : Finset (Fin (r + 1)) // n = -(I.card : ℤ)} ↦
        ringedNegativeKoszulBasis O (r + 1)
          (fun i ↦ ⟨(ρ (a i)).val, (ρ (a i)).property⟩) m I.1 n)))) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk
      (((ringedNegativeKoszulTensor O ρ a m).obj K).X q)
      (ringedNegativeKoszulSummand O ρ a m K q)))
